items.title: Shell fallback after command exits
items.text: When a `--command` finishes, Ghoztty now drops you into an interactive shell instead of closing the pane. This makes it much easier to inspect output or continue working after a one-shot command completes.

items.title: Process exit diagnostics
items.text: When a process dies unexpectedly, Ghoztty now logs detailed exit information (exit code, signal, timing) both to the terminal and to a diagnostics file, making it easier to debug what went wrong.

items.title: Debug build naming fix
items.text: The debug build is now `Ghoztty-Debug.app`, preventing conflicts with the installed release app.
